turnout.notes: Maine turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. SOS active/inactive registered/enrolled files are retained as denominator leads only until compatible official ballots-cast or voter-participation rows are collected and reconciled.

certifiedResults.uocavaHandling: State UOCAVA is loaded as a non-geographic certified result row and excluded from municipality review-row joins. Blank ballots are excluded from candidate vote totals but retained in source caveats.

reviewCharts.warning: Maine review rows pair official SOS town-level President rows with the official U.S. Senate workbook after conservative municipality-label normalization. U.S. Senate includes a major independent candidate, so Democratic/Republican dropoff fields are directional source-review inputs only. State UOCAVA is loaded in certified result totals as non-geographic and excluded from town review rows; a few true grain mismatches remain vote-share-only.

historicalBaselines.warning: Maine native historical baseline rows remain official SOS county plus State UOCAVA context for 2016 and 2020. The precinct-GIS collector separately parses the official 2012 municipal XLS, but those local rows are not part of this native historical-baseline contract. Use historical rows as contextual baselines only, not 2024 certified data.

localReportingGeometry.label: Local reporting unit
localReportingGeometry.warning: Maine's statewide presidential workbooks mix towns, plantations, townships, voting districts, and combined local units. They are not uniformly precinct-grain. No town total is duplicated across wards and no vote is proportionally allocated.
